label: Серый шаг (номер + текст)
description: Средний блок: .gray-block с номером в квадрате и текстом шага.
pug:
.iq-gray-step--gray-block.iq-gray-step
    table.iq-gray-step--w100(role="presentation")
        tr
            td.iq-gray-step--m-w.pb0
                p.iq-gray-step--number {{ number }}
            td.iq-gray-step--w-a.pb0
                p.iq-gray-step--text {{ text }}
styl:
.iq-gray-step--gray-block
  padding: 24px
  background: #F9F9F9
  border-radius: 12px
.iq-gray-step--number
  background #ECECED
  width: 54px
  max-height: 54px
  border-radius: 16px
  font-family: Helvetica !important
  color: #393A44
  font-weight: 700
  font-size: 24px
  line-height: 24px
  padding 15px 0
  text-align: center
.iq-gray-step--w100
  width 100%
.iq-gray-step--w-a
  width auto !important
  vertical-align: middle
table[class=body] table.column td, table[class=body] table.columns td.iq-gray-step--m-w
  min-width: 78px !important
  width 78px !important
  vertical-align: middle
.iq-gray-step--text
  font-family: Helvetica !important
  font-size: 18px
  color: #393A44
  letter-spacing: 0
  line-height: 26px
  font-weight 400

/* втянуто из стилей семьи при скоупе — блок больше не зависит от main.styl */
.iq-gray-step--m-w{min-width:78px !important;width:78px !important;vertical-align:middle}
